release.description:
Connect Notion to your agent so it works from the same context as your team and other agents. Connect Notion to your agent so it works from the same context as your team and other agents. Search your workspace, create and update pages, manage projects and tasks, and save your work back to Notion.

- **Find answers in your workspace:** Search your pages and databases for answers grounded in your team’s knowledge.
- **Turn chats into docs:** Save research, plans, specs, and notes as pages your team can review and edit.
- **Keep projects moving:** Create tasks, update statuses, and add notes to your databases directly from chat.
- **Share one brain across agents:** Store memories and skills in Notion so your agents follow your preferences and ways of working.

default_prompts: Create a beautiful weekly planner in Notion with a task board, daily priorities, notes, ideas, and example tasks.

skills.name: notion-build-my-engineering-wiki
skills.description: Build a personalized Notion engineering home from technical docs, project context, and chat or connected sources. Use to get started with an engineering wiki and a clear view of current work.

interface.short_description: Bring technical docs and projects together

skills.name: notion-create-my-team-handbook
skills.description: Create a team handbook in Notion from scattered processes, team documents, requests, and chat context. Make procedures easy to find, show who maintains them, and track related requests.

skills.name: notion-database-designer
skills.description: Turns scattered notes and recurring work into useful Notion trackers for requests, content plans, or team work. Use to set up or improve a tracker, choosing its fields and views from the user's needs; ordinary record updates belong to the task's workflow.

interface.short_description: Turn notes, images, and data into trackers, galleries, and charts.

skills.name: notion-knowledge-capture
skills.description: Captures conversations and supplied notes as Notion wiki pages, how-to guides, FAQs, decision records, or retrospectives. Use when saving or updating durable knowledge from existing context; use research-documentation when new source discovery and synthesis is the main task.

skills.name: notion-meeting-prep
skills.description: Prepares meeting agendas, internal pre-reads, and decision briefs using Notion context and relevant research. Use for preparing the next or upcoming meeting, meeting preparation, recurring meeting context, or updating meeting outcomes; use knowledge-capture for a standalone record of an existing discussion.

skills.name: notion-organize-my-semester
skills.description: Organize a semester in Notion from course notes, syllabi, assignments, and chat context. Use when getting organized for a course or semester to keep notes clear and upcoming work easy to find.

interface.short_description: Keep courses, notes, and deadlines together

skills.name: notion-plan-marketing-campaigns
skills.description: Organize campaign briefs, content ideas, and production work in Notion. Use when planning a marketing campaign, building a content calendar, or tracking content production.

skills.name: notion-research-documentation
skills.description: Researches questions across Notion sources and synthesizes cited briefs, comparisons, or reports. Use when answering requires discovering and reconciling workspace information, optionally with external research, and returning or saving the findings.

skills.name: notion-set-up-my-project
skills.description: Create a useful initial Notion project home with tasks, docs, and meeting notes, then work with the user to confirm the team and choose a Projects database. Use when starting or organizing a project in Notion; routine task edits, status reports, and implementing a technical spec are separate workflows.

interface.short_description: Create a project home with tasks and docs

skills.name: notion-setup
skills.description: Set up Notion so your agents can remember your preferences, find your work, and pick up where you left off.

skills.name: notion-spec-to-implementation
skills.description: Converts Notion product or technical specs into implementation plans, linked tasks, and evidence-based progress updates. Use for planning or implementing a spec, creating tasks from requirements, or reconciling implementation with spec changes.

interface.short_description: Turn specs into plans and tasks

skills.name: notion-weekly-project-digest
skills.description: Produces evidence-based weekly project or team updates by comparing reporting periods, tasks, decisions, and blockers in Notion. Use for recurring status digests; use spec-to-implementation for requirement-level implementation tracking.

interface.short_description: Summarize progress, blockers, and next steps
